related_questions.question: How much tax do I pay in Trinidad?
related_questions.snippet: Income Tax is charged for each year of income on the chargeable profits arising in that year at the rate of: 25% up to $1,000,000.00 and; 30% for every dollar over $1,000,000.00. (with effect from 2017-01-01)

related_questions.question: How to calculate Trinidad Paye?
related_questions.title: Pay As You Earn (PAYE)
list: Total Annual Income - Total Tax Deductions = Chargeable Income.
Chargable Income x Tax Rate* = Tax on Chargable Income.
Tax on Chargable Income - Tax Credits = Income Tax Liability.
Income Tax Liability ÷ Number of pay periods per year = Tax per pay period.

related_questions.question: How do I calculate tax to my total?
related_questions.title: Sales Tax Calculation Formulas
list: Sales tax amount = original price × sales tax rate as a decimal.
Sales tax rate as a decimal = sales tax percent / 100.
Original price before tax = total price after tax / (1 + sales tax rate as a decimal)
Sales tax amount = total price after tax - price before tax.

related_questions.question: How is Trinidad property tax calculated?
related_questions.snippet: PROPERTY TAX IS ONLY 3% OF THE ANNUAL RENTAL VALUE For the record, the Property Tax Act makes it clear Property Tax is only THREE PERCENT (3%) of the annual rental value for residential properties, after first deducting 10% from the Annual Rental value. It is NOT the same amount as the rental value.
